units: STL has no embedded units; native tip-to-tip span300 matches source GeneralInfo diameter0.3m, therefore coordinate interpretation is millimetres; multiply by.001 for solver metres.
axis: Tip span is Z; rotation-axis direction and origin must be confirmed from hub/section geometry before CFD, not inferred solely from span.
